title: DPD
text: Digital predistorter, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Polynomial type}, {Coefficient source} sets the source of memory-polynomial coefficients, {Coefficients} sets the memory-polynomial coefficients complex 0 0 0 0 0; {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Polynomial type
params.values: Polynomial type Memory polynomial (default) | Cross-term memory polynomial

params.name: Coefficient source
params.values: Source of memory-polynomial coefficients Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
